svg.text: WF-017 — PCLK_MODE=1: gated valid-pixel bridge; first pixel follows synchronized VSYNC

VSYNC stays active for 4 APB cycles; PCLK is stopped during VSYNC. HREF may remain active through gaps with no PCLK edge, so no pixel event occurs in a gap. P0..P3 sample at cycles 8, 12, 16, 20 and each is enqueued. This is an idealized 4-cycle drawing; the implementation requires additional T_margin and STA/SDC bundled-data timing closure.
